java_locations.role: Parses eight hex digits in RRGGBBAA order, constructing XColor from byte pairs at offsets 0, 2, 4, and 6.
Serializes zero alpha as #00000000, opaque alpha as six-digit RGB, and partial alpha as uppercase RRGGBBAA.
Maps the canonical zero-alpha sentinel #00000000 to SVG paint none before emitting shape attributes.
Admits hexadecimal entity-color tokens to HColorSet without assigning a separate alpha syntax.

rust_locations.role: Correctly retains the complete entity color token, including all eight hexadecimal digits.

Canonicalizes three- and six-digit colors but passes eight-digit input through unchanged, so downstream class paint interprets #80FF0000 as an opaque invalid-looking token instead of RRGGBBAA with zero alpha.

claimed_invariant: PlantUML hexadecimal colors have one shared canonicalization rule across renderer families. One digit is grayscale, three digits expand RGB nibbles, six digits are opaque RGB, and eight digits are RRGGBBAA. An alpha byte of 00 produces SVG paint none regardless of the RGB bytes; FF serializes as six-digit RGB; intermediate alpha remains an uppercase eight-digit SVG color. The rule belongs to color resolution, not class entities or one fixture.
causal_divergence: The frozen source supplies #80FF0000. Java parses bytes as red=0x80, green=0xFF, blue=0x00, alpha=0x00, then XColor.toSvg and SvgGraphics.fixColor reduce the fully transparent paint to none. Rust's shared resolve_color recognizes only three and six hex digits and returns the original eight-digit token, which class rendering emits verbatim as fill=#80FF0000. Both class rectangles are otherwise structurally and geometrically identical, isolating the failure to RGBA byte order and zero-alpha serialization.
planned_model_change: Extend the shared color resolver with a small typed hexadecimal parser that follows HColorSet arities and XColor.toSvg serialization. Canonicalize eight-digit RRGGBBAA for every caller, including alpha-zero none and alpha-FF contraction, while retaining existing named, three-digit, and six-digit behavior. Add renamed renderer perturbations and direct resolver tests across zero, partial, and full alpha, mixed case, and differing RGB bytes so no condition is tied to #80FF0000 or class count.
perturbation_axes: different red, green, and blue bytes
inline entity background versus shared skinparam color consumers
three-, six-, and eight-digit hexadecimal arities
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns canonical parsing and SVG serialization of simple hexadecimal colors. It does not alter gradients, named-color lookup, inline channel routing, geometry, comparator behavior, golden data, or fixture eligibility.

experimental_result.accepted_result: edge_color_hex_with_alpha becomes structurally equivalent through render_svg without oracle input. The frozen shipped-path census rises from 11,164/11,251 to 11,165/11,251, with edge-cases moving from 753/777 to 754/777 and every other family unchanged.
experimental_result.model_evidence: The shared resolver now implements HColorSet's one-, three-, six-, and eight-digit arities and XColor.toSvg's RRGGBBAA serialization. A direct fresh matrix covers alpha 00, 01, 7F, FE, and FF with mixed casing and unrelated RGB bytes. A renamed three-class chain confirms zero, partial, and opaque alpha all flow through ordinary entity paint independently of fixture labels and topology.
